title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Standards for Conviction and Sentencing in Drug Cases

articles.content_en: Article 5 Illegal cultivation of five thousand or more but less than thirty thousand cannabis plants shall be determined as the "relatively large quantities" of illegal cultivation of cannabis as stipulated in Article 351(1)(1) of the Criminal Law; illegal cultivation of thirty thousand or more cannabis plants shall be determined as the "large quantities" of illegal cultivation of cannabis as stipulated in Article 351(2) of the Criminal Law.
